children: Parabilis Medicines reported updated Phase 1/2 data for zolucatetide in desmoid tumors, showing ORR 72.2% at 32 weeks (13/18) at ≥450 mg and DCR 100% across 46 evaluable patients, and said FDA aligned on dose, placebo control and PFS for a registrational Phase 3 starting H1 2027.

Selected regimen: 450 mg wkly→300 mg q2w

Phase 3 start H1 2027; topline 2029

Fast Track & Orphan designations
May enable expedited interactions and market exclusivity if approved.
